description: 산림청_과거산사태 정보 [landslides and debris flows] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 산림청. 산림청 과거 산사태 정보 서비스는 산사태 재해년도, 산사태 재해명, 시도명, 시군구명, 읍면명, 산사태 피해면적을 기준으로 과거 발생 이력 데이터를 제공하는 오픈API 서비스입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 산림청. Its tags are 산림청, 산사태, 과거산사태정보, 재해, 산림재해. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-11-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
